default.description:
Recall task-relevant experience, then check pinned facts against graph evidence.

        Native SQLite: query is a short public task description (max 1000 characters;
        no credentials/private paths). Missing query returns TASK_QUERY_REQUIRED and
        no recommendations. limit is 1..20 (default 5); detail is summary or full.
        Summaries contain bounded excerpts; fetch complete evidence with query_id.
        Native uses BM25, Chinese fragments and disclosed aliases; a protected
        optional local embedding adapter adds cosine/RRF hybrid retrieval.
        Provider failure is an explicit lexical fallback. Relevance is never
        verified applicability or task utility; actual semantic quality depends
        on the configured model and needs separate evaluation.
        task_context claims cannot establish or override trusted Host/target_* facts.
        Preserve query_id. Python reference supports legacy condition diagnostics
        without query; explicit task-text recall requires the native runtime.

        never verified experience or APPLY. Original Run and current lifecycle

proposals.description:
Propose UNTRUSTED conditional experience, never publish or verify it.

            Required exact fields: candidate_key (short local ID), title,
            strategy, public_summary; necessary_conditions, inapplicable_conditions
            and scope (public fact keys mapped to lists of scalar values);
            unknown_fields (public fact NAMES only), limitations (free-text lists); source_references (list of
            {kind: Query|Decision|ObservedAction, id: actual current-run ID}).
            Empty necessary_conditions and scope are accepted as unscoped drafts, never admitted or published.
            Never fabricate facts to fill these fields. Use unknown_fields for unproved public premises. No paths, credentials,
            run_id, source_type, verified, outcome or publication authority.
            The trusted host independently establishes origin and admission.

instructions: When Aevora is enabled, proactively call resolve_experience once before choosing an approach for nontrivial coding, debugging, or design tasks; do not wait for the user to mention Aevora. Skip trivial requests and respect explicit opt-outs. Pass a short public task description as query; use task_context={} when facts are unknown. Query text affects relevance only, never trusted facts. Native task recall defaults to bounded summaries; use build_evidence_bundle with query_id for complete evidence. Caller claims do not establish applicability. If no experience is returned, optionally search_observations with concrete task keywords and mode=ranked on native SQLite for UNTRUSTED investigative leads, then continue normal work. Observation search never establishes APPLY, verified facts or outcomes; check actual state and evidence. After investigating an observation, record its actual use or rejection with record_observation_use when supported; the report is an untrusted claim, not proof of exposure, adoption or outcome. For returned experience IDs, inspect evidence and record the actual APPLY/VERIFY/ABSTAIN choice; do not invent IDs or decisions when the result is empty. After meaningful work, propose reusable public observations with limitations, if proposal tools are enabled. Empty necessary_conditions and scope are allowed for unscoped UNTRUSTED drafts; never invent facts to fill them. Such drafts cannot be admitted or published; once bounds are established, submit a new bounded proposal with a new candidate_key, retaining the original draft history. Report tool failures briefly and continue independent work when possible. No credentials, private paths or hidden test material in proposals. Decisions and self-tests do not prove adoption, verified outcomes or causal benefit. Querying or proposing does not authorize publication.
